articles.title: HC questions Telegram ban ahead of NEET re-test
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court questioned the government's justification for temporarily restricting the messaging platform Telegram for nearly 150 million users in India. This measure was implemented ahead of the NEET re-examination. The court is seeking a detailed explanation from the government regarding the necessity and proportionality of such a widespread restriction, highlighting concerns about its impact on a vast user base.

articles.title: David Sheiner Dead: ‘Odd Couple,’ ‘Twilight Zone’ Actor Was 98
articles.summary: Veteran character actor David Sheiner, known for his memorable role as one of the poker players alongside Walter Matthau and Jack Lemmon in the classic 1968 big-screen adaptation of 'The Odd Couple,' has passed away at 98. His death marks the end of a long and familiar career in Hollywood, remembered for his distinctive performances.

articles.title: Massive Tohoku Earthquake Sent a Seismic Wave That Shifted All of Japan
articles.summary: In March 2011, a powerful magnitude 9 Tohoku earthquake struck off Japan's Honshu coast, causing six minutes of violent ground shaking. This seismic event triggered a massive tsunami, resulting in widespread devastation and significant loss of life. The disaster underscored the immense destructive power of natural phenomena and highlighted the critical importance of advanced disaster preparedness and early warning systems globally.

articles.title: United States reviews troop levels in Europe, cuts NATO assets in major military drawdown
articles.summary: The Pentagon is significantly reducing its military presence on a continent, withdrawing fighter jets, refueling tankers, and thousands of troops. This strategic move aims to shrink the US military footprint to pre-2022 levels, indicating a recalibration of deployment priorities or response to evolving regional dynamics. Aspirants should note such shifts in global power projection.

articles.title: NECA Drops New Sailor Raphael from TMNT 1987 Cartoon
articles.summary: NECA has announced a new collectible for fans of the classic 1987 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles series. The release is a 7-inch action figure of Sailor Raphael, featuring a unique Sailor-disguise. This revelation caters to enthusiasts and collectors of vintage pop culture memorabilia.

articles.title: Convoy of Hope Expands Summer Feeding Program to Help Children Fight Summer Hunger
articles.summary: Convoy of Hope is significantly expanding its national distribution network to 420 partners across the United States. This crucial effort targets the 'summer grocery gap' impacting over 20 million American children who face food insecurity when schools are closed. The scaled initiative aims to ensure vulnerable children have continued access to essential nutrition during the summer months, addressing a critical social challenge.

articles.title: NATO agrees to modernize nuclear capabilities to enhance deterrence
articles.summary: NATO's recent commitment to upgrading its nuclear posture signals a response to deepening geopolitical tensions and a continuously rising defense spending trajectory. This strategic enhancement underscores the alliance's focus on maintaining effective deterrence and security amidst evolving global threats, emphasizing the critical role of nuclear capabilities in its defense policy for SSB aspirants.
